items.name: Hadron application engine
items.detail: Electron 38.8.4 and Node 22.22.0 are included. Do not install Electron separately.

items.name: ChatGPT subscription engine
items.detail: Bundled with Hadron. Connect your own ChatGPT subscription in Subscriptions.

items.name: Claude subscription engine
items.detail: Bundled with Hadron. Connect your own Claude subscription if you want Claude agents.

items.name: Windows worker controller
items.detail: Included. Controls the lifetime of AI and project-check processes.

items.name: Windows PowerShell
items.detail: Windows component used to preserve file permissions when applying reviewed changes. If missing, repair this Windows component before project editing.

items.name: Visual Studio Code
items.detail: Optional editor for opening your project yourself. Hadron does not require it.

items.name: Git
items.detail: Optional for projects that use Git version control.

items.name: External Node.js and npm
items.detail: Optional for projects requiring npm package installation or external Node commands. Hadron’s built-in Node test/build-script checks use its bundled engine.
